mapper.sql: a.dcr21_relate_icr_id AS relate_icr_id, a.dcr21_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id, a.dcr21_icr_class_tree_id AS icr_class_tree_id, f_icr_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.icr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name, b.icr01_content AS content, b.icr01_submit_to AS submit_to, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(sch03_deadline.*) - 1 || '건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_schedule_cd IN ('6','7') AND b.icr01_class_tree_id = sch03_info_id AND b.icr01_company_id = sch03_company_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cycle_name, b.icr01_related_law AS related_law, b.icr01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code, a.dcr21_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dcr21_relate_icr a INNER JOIN icr01_class_tree b ON a.dcr21_icr_class_tree_id = b.icr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr21_dcr_class_tree_id = #{dcrClassTreeId} ORDER BY a.dcr21_relate_icr_id
SELECT FROM dcr21_relate_icr a INNER JOIN icr01_class_tree b ON a.dcr21_icr_class_tree_id = b.icr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr21_relate_icr_id = #{relateIcrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr21_relate_icr (dcr21_relate_icr_id, dcr21_dcr_class_tree_id, dcr21_icr_class_tree_id, dcr21_company_id, dcr21_note) VALUES (#{relateIcrId}, #{dcrClassTreeId}, #{icrClassTreeId}, #{companyId}, #{note})
